revision_reason: Independent source review recommended a minimum of 512 structurally valid units. The triangle-support outcome had not been computed or inspected when this stricter threshold was adopted.
observed_record_grammar: lang1 lang2 docid1 docid2, four space-separated fields

definitions.triangle_consistent_triple: An English document e, French document f and Spanish document s for which all three official pairs (e,f), (e,s), and (f,s) are present.
definitions.one_triple_per_english_document: For each English document with one or more consistent triangles, retain the lexicographically first (f,s) pair to avoid duplicate English content.
definitions.deterministic_confirmation_document_samp: Order retained canonical identities eng|fra|spa by SHA-256 and reserve the first 512 identities, conditional on at least 512 qualifying identities.

advance_rule.document_level: Advance PGV to document-qualified only if at least 512 one-per-English triangle-consistent triples exist and every parsed target record has matching language prefixes.
advance_rule.sentence_level: Remain not qualified until segment archives prove a deterministic set of content-aligned three-language rows.
advance_rule.outcome_firewall: No corpus text or tokenizer output may be read in this diagnostic.
